basic_profile.bio: Avid Star Wars fan and gamer based in Seattle. I've been playing Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes for over four years, and my Empire team is my pride. Outside of gaming, I enjoy running and am working my way through the C25K program. I'm a software engineer by day and spend my evenings either gaming or catching up on the latest episodes of TV shows featuring Katherine McNamara. Single and enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies. Typically online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of Star Wars lore and strategy games, acquired through years of fandom and active participation in related forums. Self-taught in programming and gaming strategies, with a professional background in software development.
